Keeping goal_known published first by toy_is_goal_known satisfies every reader, the goal branch (clearance-aware toy_avoid_obstacles, falling back to toy_drive_to_goal) takes priority once disclosure latches, and below it gen_b_1f2fe8016b1441dc is tried before the sweep: whenever the intended heading has a return inside 6 m — exactly the doorway/near-furniture case that stalled the previous run — it commands the braking-admissible sqrt(2*d*a_brake) speed so the robot commits through the gap instead of stalling, and on open floor its precondition is false, it FAILs, and toy_sweep_for_goal resumes covering unexplored floor in the newly reached room.
